messages:
gina: CI failing on docs linkcheck: broken fragment on /sdk/clients.html -> '#create-client-credentials' not found.

tarek: Hmm that endpoint was recently reworded in the SDK snippets PR. Can you paste the heading?

gina: In sdk/clients.mdx the heading is `### Create client credentials (server)` which renders to `#create-client-credentials-server` but the TOC link is `#create-client-credentials`. Looks like someone removed the short-heading anchor when refactoring examples.

devx-bot: linkcheck report:
- pages scanned: 260
- broken fragments: 1 (sdk/clients.mdx -> expected '#create-client-credentials')

sam.theo: Quick fixes: update link to full anchor, or set explicit id on the heading. I'd prefer explicit ids for stability in examples that link into specific subsections.

gina: I'll open a small PR to add an explicit id: `### Create client credentials (server) {#create-client-credentials}` and update the sidebar reference to that anchor. Patch:```mdx
- ### Create client credentials (server)
+ ### Create client credentials (server) {#create-client-credentials}
```

noura: Also let's add a tiny docs lint rule that flags when a link points to an anchor that doesn't exist in the same PR. Might be overkill but would save churn.

tarek: For now explicit id and update the failing link. I'll review the PR. After merge we can consider the lint rule (probably a remark plugin).

gina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2419 (WIP). Running linkcheck locally before pushing.

devx-bot: Suggestion: add the `{#anchor}` pattern to our docs style guide so authors know to add stable anchors for example links.

gina: Good idea — will add a checklist item in the PR description. CI passed for me locally, but running remote CI now.

sam.theo: Merged after quick review. Linkcheck on CI green. Thanks! :tada:
